description: Complete searchable archive of HM Land Registry Price Paid Data (England & Wales): every residential sale lodged for registration since Jan 1995, with the monthly additions/changes/deletions applied, plus derived analytics — median and mean price by county, district, town/city, property type, tenure and postcode area/district, and volume by month and year. title: UK Price Paid Intelligence — England & Wales Property Sales Archive 1995–Present
